base.name: I Am the King
base.text: When the Game ends, replace a Councillor with an eligible player, even under The King's Seal. They draw 1 Scheme.

hurrem.name: Margaery Tyrell

base.name: The King's Ear
base.text: At the Judgment, you choose which Councillor gets the Gold instead of the King.

favor.name: Rose and Thorn
favor.text: In one wave, play two cards instead of one.

hurrem.flavor: I don't want to be a queen. I want to be the queen.

ibrahim.name: Tywin Lannister

base.name: Send Him to Bed
base.text: This Crisis you appoint both Councillors instead of the King; you may appoint yourself.

favor.name: Gold of the Rock
favor.text: From now on, whenever Arbor Red is served while you are a Councillor, gain 1 Gold.

ibrahim.flavor: A king who must say "I am the king" is no true king.

sahsultan.name: Cersei Lannister

base.name: The Queen's Displeasure
base.text: On your Dissent turn, dissent for free and pick the replacement. It counts as your Dissent this Crisis.

favor.name: Banishment
favor.text: Pick a player: next Crisis they can't become a Councillor by any means.

sahsultan.flavor: Everything I do is for my children.

base.name: The Lord Commander's Seat
base.text: When the Game ends, before I Am the King, take a Councillor's seat if eligible, even under The King's Seal.

favor.name: Kingslayer's Price
favor.text: Whoever dissents against you gives you the Gold they paid.

hatice.name: Tyrion Lannister

base.name: The Slap
base.text: Before the Game, pick a player: this Crisis no Scheme unseats them and they lose no Gold, Judgment included.

favor.name: I Drink and I Know Things
favor.text: Pick two players besides the King and you: learn in secret if they are on the same side.

hatice.flavor: I wish I were the monster you think I am.

rustem.name: Petyr Baelish

base.name: A Private Word
base.text: Before the King appoints, talk with him alone for up to a minute.

favor.name: Chaos Is a Ladder
favor.text: When a wave flips, move a Scheme played on you to another player.

rustem.flavor: The crown owes me a fortune. Dead kings don't pay.

barbaros.name: Varys

base.name: Stolen Letters
base.text: Take a random Scheme from another player's hand, then discard down to your hand limit.

favor.name: Little Birds
favor.text: After the Pouring, look in secret at the cup or cups the Hand discarded.

barbaros.flavor: I serve the realm, and the realm needs a king.

gritti.name: Tycho Nestoris

base.name: Interest
base.text: Pick another player. The next time they gain Gold, you gain 1 too.

favor.name: The Iron Bank Will Have Its Due
favor.text: Look in secret at the top 3 Cups; you may put one on the bottom.

gritti.flavor: The Iron Bank backs the throne that pays.

sarlken.name: Oberyn Martell

base.name: Not Here for a Seat
base.text: When Councillors are appointed, before Dissents, hand your seat to an eligible player. Gain 1 Gold; draw nothing.

favor.name: Unbowed, Unbent, Unbroken
favor.text: Your Schemes count as cards of an open field.

sarlken.flavor: Elia Martell. Her children. Say their names.

tahmasp.name: Daenerys Targaryen

base.name: Mother of Dragons
base.text: When the Crisis flips, you pick its field: Small Council, Holdfast or Red Keep.

favor.name: Dracarys
favor.text: Everyone, you included, keeps 1 Scheme of their choice and discards the rest.

tahmasp.flavor: I will take what is mine with fire and blood.

daye.name: Ilyn Payne
daye.text: Play a Scheme as The Queen Regent's Command; you can't pick yourself.
daye.flavor: The King's Justice never says a word.

bali.name: Sandor Clegane
bali.text: Play a Scheme as The King's Seal.
bali.flavor: Joffrey's sworn shield. Nobody gets past the Hound.

ayas.name: Janos Slynt
ayas.text: Play a Scheme as Stripped of Office.
ayas.flavor: He sold one Hand. He can sell another.

matrakci.name: Ros
matrakci.text: Play a Scheme as Paid Informer.

sumbul.name: Bronn
sumbul.text: Play a Scheme as Sworn Sword; you pick its field.
sumbul.flavor: A sellsword sells to whoever pays more.

nigar.name: Grand Maester Pycelle
nigar.text: Play a Scheme as Dark Wings.
nigar.flavor: Every raven passes through his rookery.

ebussuud.name: Olenna Tyrell
ebussuud.flavor: The Queen of Thorns knows what was in the cup.

gulsah.name: Lancel Lannister
gulsah.flavor: He served one king the strongwine.

seker.name: Qyburn
seker.text: Play a Scheme as Maester's Remedy.
seker.flavor: A maester without a chain, and without scruples.

gulfem.name: Dontos Hollard
gulfem.text: Play a Scheme as A Fool's Wager.
gulfem.flavor: A drunk fool with a necklace to give.

iskender.name: Kevan Lannister
iskender.text: Play a Scheme as The Crown's Ledgers.
iskender.flavor: Tywin's steady brother keeps the books.

firuze.name: Shae
firuze.text: Play a Scheme as The King's Eye.

gulaga.name: Sansa Stark
gulaga.text: Play a Scheme as Hold Your Tongue.
gulaga.flavor: A hostage learns to say nothing at all.

lokman.name: Podrick Payne
lokman.text: Play a Scheme as Kingsguard Watch.
lokman.flavor: The squire at the door sees who comes in.

akil-hocasi.name: Sworn Sword
akil-hocasi.text: This Crisis, cancels the other Schemes of its field played on this player.
akil-hocasi.flavor: A sword that's paid for stays drawn.

muhur.name: The King's Seal
muhur.text: Place on a Councillor. This Crisis no Scheme can replace them; I Am the King still can.
muhur.flavor: Lion and stag, pressed in wax.

valide.name: The Queen Regent's Command
valide.text: Place on a Councillor. Replace them with an eligible player, you included. The newcomer takes the same seat.
valide.flavor: The king is a boy. His mother is not.

azil.name: Stripped of Office
azil.text: Place on a Councillor. The King replaces them with an eligible player; the newcomer takes the same seat.
azil.flavor: You are relieved of your duties.

casus.name: Paid Informer
casus.text: When the Game ends, see in secret which Schemes this player played this Crisis, and on whom.
casus.flavor: Everyone talks for a little silver.

muhurlu-evrak.name: Dark Wings
muhurlu-evrak.text: Look in secret at the top 3 Cups, then put them back in the same order.

saray-tabibi.name: Maester's Remedy
saray-tabibi.text: This player loses no Gold this Crisis, Judgment included.
saray-tabibi.flavor: An antidote, if you can pay for it.

iftira.name: Slander
iftira.flavor: A name, a whisper, a fall.

kefalet.name: A Fool's Wager
kefalet.text: Place on a Councillor. If still one at the Pouring: gain 1 Gold if Arbor Red is served, lose 1 if a Strangler is.
kefalet.flavor: Only a fool bets on a councillor.

teftis.name: Confession
teftis.text: Place on a Councillor. After the Pouring, look in secret at the cup or cups they discarded.
teftis.flavor: Every cup that left the table is accounted for.

defterdar.name: The Crown's Ledgers
defterdar.text: Place on the Hand. If still the Hand at the Pouring, they draw 4 instead of 3 and discard 2.
defterdar.flavor: The crown owes millions. Someone keeps count.

nobet.name: Kingsguard Watch
nobet.text: When the Game ends, pick one Scheme others played on this player this Crisis; learn in secret who played it.
nobet.flavor: The white cloaks see who comes and goes.

nazar.name: The King's Eye
nazar.text: Place on a Councillor. If the Judgment falls on them this Crisis, it gives or takes 2 instead of 1.
nazar.flavor: Joffrey is watching. Pray he's amused.

sukut.name: Hold Your Tongue
sukut.text: This player can't play a Scheme in the next wave.
sukut.flavor: At this court, silence keeps your head.

divanda-nufuz.name: Strip the Chain
divanda-nufuz.text: Unseat a Councillor with a Scheme.
divanda-nufuz.flavor: Every chain of office comes off.

suphe.name: Under Suspicion
suphe.text: Be a Councillor when a Strangler is served.
suphe.flavor: I swear the cup was clean when I passed it!

takdir.name: A Toast to the King
takdir.text: Be a Councillor when Arbor Red is served.

gozden.name: A Lighter Purse
gozden.flavor: A Lannister always pays. So do the rest of us.

kulisci.name: Many Threads
kulisci.text: Place Schemes on three different players.

yukselen.name: A Seat at the Table
yukselen.text: Be a Councillor in two Crises.
yukselen.flavor: The chair is worth more than the man.

hedef.name: Marked
hedef.text: Have other players place 2 or more Schemes on you in one Crisis.
hedef.flavor: Every knife in the room points your way.

ortak.name: Stand Surety
ortak.text: Place The King's Seal or A Fool's Wager on a Councillor.

koltuk.name: Climb the Ladder
koltuk.text: Become a Councillor through a Scheme.

kulak.name: Eavesdropper
kulak.text: Use Paid Informer, Dark Wings, Confession or Kingsguard Watch.
kulak.flavor: The walls of the Red Keep have ears.

yeniceri.name: Riot in Flea Bottom
yeniceri.text: Players with 0 Gold draw 1 Scheme each.
yeniceri.flavor: The bread runs out and the mob turns on the royal party.

hazine.name: Debt to the Iron Bank
hazine.text: Nobody can draw a Scheme this Crisis.
hazine.flavor: The crown owes Braavos more than it can pay.

venedik.name: The Tyrells Arrive
venedik.text: The players on either side of the King draw 1 Scheme each.
venedik.flavor: Highgarden brings grain, an army and a bride.

harem.name: Bastard Letters
harem.text: The player with the least Gold draws 1 Scheme; on a tie the King picks.
harem.flavor: Stannis's letters say the king is Jaime's son.

macar.name: Battle of the Blackwater
macar.text: Nobody draws a Scheme this Crisis.
macar.flavor: Wildfire on the bay. Nobody has time to scheme.

muhur.name: A Stone Goes Missing
muhur.text: Last Crisis's Councillors draw 1 Scheme each.
muhur.flavor: One stone is missing from Sansa's necklace.

divan.name: Small Council Quarrel
divan.text: Last Crisis's Councillors draw 1 Scheme each.
divan.flavor: Tyrion drags his chair to the head of the table.

sehzade.name: Who Marries Tommen?
sehzade.text: The players on either side of the King draw 1 Scheme each.
sehzade.flavor: If Joffrey falls, the next boy needs a bride.

istanbul.name: Talk in the Taverns
istanbul.text: Everyone but the King draws 1 Scheme.
istanbul.flavor: Every alehouse in King's Landing has a theory.

irakeyn.name: News of the Red Wedding
irakeyn.text: The player with the least Gold draws 1 Scheme; on a tie the King picks.
irakeyn.flavor: The war is won at the Twins, and nobody trusts the winners.

isabella.name: The Stark Girl Is Gone
isabella.text: Last Crisis's Councillors draw 1 Scheme each.
isabella.flavor: Arya slipped out of the Red Keep. Whoever had the watch answers for it.

h.name: Arbor Red
text: Goes on Long May He Reign.
Judgment: the King gives a Councillor 1 Gold.

x.name: Strangler
text: Judgment: the King takes 1 Gold from a Councillor.
x.flavor: «I swear the cup was clean when I passed it!»

loyalist.name: Loyalist
text: You win with 4 Arbor Red on Long May He Reign.

traitor.name: Turncloak
text: You win with 5 Stranglers on the Purple Wedding.

sorusturma.name: The Black Cells
sorusturma.text: The King names an Interrogator, who looks in secret at one player's Allegiance, then says whatever they like.

hazineDefteri.name: Iron Bank Ledger
hazineDefteri.text: Before the next Crisis the King names a player, who looks in secret at the top 3 Cups.

fermanRefresh.name: The King's Justice
fermanRefresh.text: The King may use I Am the King again. He never holds it twice.

strings.tagline: Someone at this table poured the wine.
strings.endLoyalty: The fourth {term.hizmet} is served. Long may he reign.
strings.endTreason: The fifth {term.hiyanet} is served. {term.suleyman:the} is dead.
strings.pref.music.why: A quiet loop in D minor.
strings.err.exiled: A banished player can't be {term.minister:a} this {term.crisis}.
strings.log.surgun: {who} is banished this {term.crisis}: they can't be {term.minister:a}.
strings.err.ownSeat: You can't dissent against your own seat.
strings.ask.objectNotSelf: You can't dissent against your own seat, but you can against the other.
strings.wait.objectionLast: {now} may dissent now; theirs is the last word.
strings.wait.kader: The Pouring: nobody talks, nobody shows a cup.
strings.ask.kaderSecond: {first} passed you two cups. Serve one.
strings.ask.hazineName: {treason.hazineDefteri}: who looks at the top 3 Cups?
strings.ask.appointHow: Tap the seat for the {term.min1}, then the one for the {term.min2}.
strings.rules.goal.win: The {term.loyalist:pl} win at {loyalty} cups of {term.hizmet}, the {term.traitor:pl} at {treason} {term.hiyanet:pl}: the last one is {treason.death}. More in [[fate]].
strings.rules.crisis.kader: The {term.min1} pours 3 cups in secret, tosses 1 and passes 2. The {term.min2} tosses 1 and serves the other. Nobody talks. More in [[fate]].
strings.rules.crisis.result: The served cup goes on its track; some {term.hiyanet} spaces hand {term.suleyman:the} a power. Then the {term.minister:pl} explain themselves. They may claim anything, but nobody shows a hidden card.
strings.rules.fate.min1: *The {term.min1}* pours 3 cups in secret, tosses 1 unseen and passes 2 to the {term.min2}.
strings.rules.fate.min2: *The {term.min2}* tosses 1 of the 2 and serves the other for all to see.
strings.rules.fate.silence: Nobody talks or shows a cup meanwhile. Either {term.minister} may toss or serve anything, so a {term.hiyanet} can always be blamed on the other.
strings.rules.fate.deck: The cups hold {h} {term.hizmet} and {x} {term.hiyanet:pl}: mostly poison. Tossed cups are shuffled back in when they run low.
